description: The Trinidad and Tobago Museum (TTCM) is committed to gathering, protecting, and sharing information on the legacy of T&T Carnival. T&T Carnival is distinctive, and its museum is sure to be too. The museum will honor freedom and the coming together of peoples in the same way as the festival. Its interactive analog and digital exhibitions will provide visitors a 365-day carnival museum experience. Listed opening hours: Wednesday - Saturday: 10:00AM - 5:00PM Sunday: 2:00PM - 5:00PM. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
